info: 파리 국립장식미술학교(ÉnsAD, 'Arts Déco')는 PSL 연구대학의 구성원인 공립 그랑제콜 예술·디자인 학교로, 파리 위름 가에 있습니다. The École nationale supérieure des Arts Décoratifs (ÉnsAD) also known as Arts Decos' and École des Arts décoratifs, is a public grande école of art and design, constituent member of PSL Research University. The school is located in the Rue d'Ulm in Paris.
